purpose: WM-S main chain configuration, not an executed training receipt: original leave-PI-and-wall-out plus TRAIN switching/direct-output data
notes: GiB means 2^30 bytes. Original-pack byte sizes are unavailable in supplied inputs; measure before staging. Stage records exact logical switching source bytes before local rsync.
The trainer is TRAIN-only: pack_switching_val / pack_switching_test and their sidecars are never staged for training.
The shell preflight checks the installed CLI and required paths without loading trajectory arrays. This file documents its configuration and integration contract.
Original frozen source metadata may describe mixed splits; retain it unchanged. Load only required original arrays via the TRAIN-aware loader and read-only TRAIN outcome/identity/overlay sidecars.
No GPU, SUMO, remote call, CAL, sealed, chunk-5, J4B, INC1 or HOLDOUT outcome access was performed to implement this chain. ZERO_SHOT_HELDOUT.json is exclusion metadata only.

original.recipe: _in/run3_chain.sh and _in/C1_struct_TRAIN_RECEIPT.json; externally rebuilt leave-PI-and-wall-out lists required

packs.name: pack_v3
packs.role: base (pack 0, outcomes sidecar via WM_N1_TRAIN_OUTCOMES, identities via WM_N1_TRAIN_IDENTITIES)

original.window_counts: not asserted; externally built original PI-and-wall exclusions must affect both training and monitoring

size_gib.scope: one TRAIN switching pack including timelines and TRAIN sidecars/metadata; excludes val/test packs

switching.counts_kind: builder planning counts, not independently measured here
switching.monitoring: optional SW_WINDOWS_VAL must be TRAIN-scoped and world-disjoint; otherwise --switch-val-frac .1 derives a TRAIN world split

curriculum.note: fixed four-stage curriculum; no 300 s stage; same active objectives in smoke and full

execution.interpreter_note: gpuA proven in supplied run3; gpuB must confirm layout or override PY. No conda run.
execution.cpu_guard: one-second /proc/stat sampling; idle busy cores <=1 and load1 <=1 before timing; during smoke busy cores <=OMP+1; contamination stops and invalidates timing
execution.overwrite_policy: new SW_ROOT for stage, new W for run; preserve partial staging and failed runs, never retry

extras.syntax: whitespace-separated scalar argv; no shell evaluation; fixed-contract overrides refused

execution.loss_gate: wms.gate_stages --stages 10,30,60,120 --require-terms position,speed,lane,traffic,stability,conservation --ramp-end-s 1; finite shares for all six terms in all four stages

staging.local_command: SW_STAGE_SRC=/local/train-export SW_ROOT=/new/train-destination WINDOWS_TRAIN=/original/train.json WINDOWS_VAL=/original/monitor.json EXCLUDE=/original/pi-wall.json bash _out/train_main_chain.sh stage
staging.coordinator_note: Templates require configured gpuA/gpuB SSH aliases. Rsync executes on gpuA with a local destination and one remote source. Coordinator must apply the same source allowlist/symlink refusal and check exact source sizes and >=10 GiB remaining before/after transfer. Templates are not executed by the chain.
staging.originals_on_gpuB: provide PACK_V3/PACK_DSPEED/PACK_DAMPING and identity/overlay/outcome overrides to existing read-only originals; no whole original-root transfer. Any separately authorized original staging must enumerate required arrays, preserve mixed frozen metadata, and include TRAIN outcome sidecars only.
staging.optional_monitor_list: not part of six-path automatic stage allowlist; supply SW_WINDOWS_VAL separately if needed

integration_verified: --leave-pi-wall-out filters original and switching training and monitoring; EXCLUDE reaches original monitoring; start shifting disabled to preserve exclusions.
--loss-share-logging records all six finite gradient-norm shares at each stage; zero-gradient conservation/stability are visible rather than fabricated nonzero values.
Reviewed traffic loss fix already present in branch; chain uses ramp 0/1 for identical active smoke/full objectives.
Switch monitoring world overlap refuses; held-world/family exclusion has no allow bypass.
Mmap-backed packs, workers=0 and per-process memory monitor; optional hybrid FLAGS and BRAKING_FLAGS remain empty by default.

verification.scope: local shell syntax and standalone chain guards; synthetic workspace fixtures and mocked subprocess/proc inputs only; no trainer imports, training, staging real packs, remote calls or outcome checks
verification.failure_history: Initial 13-test run had one assertion failure because local-only source rejection preceded existing-destination refusal on Windows drive paths; guard ordering corrected, subsequent 15-test suite passed.
verification.integration_note: CLI flags and trainer contracts verified locally; real data and GPU smoke not executed. See TRAINSETUP_READY.md for complete verification including synthetic strict-gate refusal.
